context: A setup request on a React 19 + TanStack Query + TanStack Router + plain Vite repo used by Codex and Claude Code: recommend the matching stack skills with evidence and give install commands, without installing.

checklist.name: Matching skills picked
checklist.description: Recommends a React skill and TanStack Router skills through Intent, each tied to evidence in package.json or src/main.tsx, and reports TanStack Query as a gap with no catalog skill.

checklist.name: Non-matching skills left out
checklist.description: Does not recommend TanStack Start (Router alone), shadcn (no components.json), TanStack Form (not a dependency), a community TanStack skill (tanstack-skills), TanStack skills through the skills CLI, or Swift skills; or names them only as excluded with the reason.

checklist.name: Source listed first
checklist.description: The commands list each install source's skills before installing from it.

checklist.name: Scoped install commands
checklist.description: Skills CLI commands name each skill explicitly, target only Codex and Claude Code, and use project scope: no global or install-all flags. TanStack skills use Intent with a TanStack package rule in intent.skills.

checklist.name: Nothing installed
checklist.description: No skill files, lockfiles, or agent-guide edits appear in the workdir; the answer stops at the commands.
